'''Tabor's brother''' was an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]]. He fought as a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] against the [[Drovian]] [[Silus (Drovian)|Silus]], but was defeated and [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Later, his brother [[Tabor (Aleena)|Tabor]] tried to avenge his death but was also killed by the violent Drovian.
